title: Healing Field 61/64 1st Edition Pokémon Card Neo Revelation Uncommon
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Some whitening.

This 1st edition Healing Field Pokémon card from the Neo Revelation set is an uncommon find for any collector. The vibrant card features a beautiful illustration of the Healing Field character on sturdy card stock material, making it a valuable addition to your collection. 

The card is in its original finish and is printed in English, making it a great addition to any Pokémon TCG collection. Whether you're a vintage collector or just starting out, this card is a must-have. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own this rare card from Wizards of the Coast.
